item.title: Роботрак Яндекса прошёл погрузку и разгрузку без водителя за рулём / Yandex tests driverless container handling at an active yard
item.description: The truck drove about 1.5 km through an operating yard and completed a container operation, with a remote operator and onboard observer still involved. (source: https://autonomy.yandex.ru/blog/kak-my-nauchili-robotrak-samostoyatelno-rabotat-na-kontejnernoj-ploshadke)

item.title: Physicl привлекла $10 млн на данные для обучения роботов / Physicl raises $10 million for targeted robot training data
item.description: Its Studio product recreates conditions in which a model fails, letting researchers train and evaluate changes in simulation. (source: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/06/3397485/0/en/physicl-raises-10-million-to-solve-physical-ai-s-edge-case-gap.html)

item.title: Amazon открыла Alexa for Shopping доступ к покупкам по SMS / Amazon brings Alexa for Shopping to text messages
item.description: A small invited group in the US can text the shopping agent, with broader access planned over the coming weeks. (source: https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/alexa-for-shopping-text-to-shop)

item.title: Meta добавила создаваемые по описанию пространства в Muse / Meta adds prompt-built spaces to the Muse app
item.description: Users describe a tracker, planner or project board and Muse builds a space inside the app. Meta says it is available wherever Muse is already offered.

item.title: Serve Robotics предложила другим компаниям сервисы для роботов / Serve Robotics opens its physical AI tools to other robot builders
item.description: Physical AI Services packages robot connectivity, data curation and data from Serve's own fleet. Serve names Bedrock Robotics among its launch customers.

item.title: Meta запустила голосовые разговоры с аватаром Muse в США / Meta rolls out voice conversations with the Muse avatar in the US
item.description: Muse Realtime Voice and Avatar bring live conversations to mobile, web and Mac. Support for AI glasses and the planned Charm device is still upcoming.

item.title: OpenAI представила GPT-6 Cyber для авторизованных исследований безопасности / OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber for authorized security research
item.description: The model targets vulnerability discovery and validation. Initial API and Codex access is limited to selected approved Daybreak Red users.

item.title: Dropbox договорилась купить Tigris Data за $350 млн / Dropbox agrees to buy Tigris Data for about $350 million
item.description: The AI-oriented object storage acquisition has not closed. Dropbox expects completion in the fourth quarter and also announced DBX Agent Cloud.

item.title: Aina открыла предзаказ кольца с экраном и управлением ИИ / Aina opens preorders for a screen-equipped AI control ring
item.description: The ring combines an OLED display, microphone, speaker and physical controller. The company expects first shipments in early 2027; it is a preorder, not a mass-market release.
